discovery.lexical_source: existing RBG-4 concept pairs, newly balanced target/label conditions
discovery.status: exploratory behavioral localization and site selection

locked.scope: selected matched causal contrast, not a rerun of the entire factorial

behavioral_factors.frames: strategic full connected design; device state replication on first four families
behavioral_factors.target_and_label_permutation: both values crossed within every family

behavior_gate.state: assertion-minus-opaque matching/opposed accuracy contrast >= .15, assertion margin contrast >= .5
behavior_gate.binding: prose bound-minus-unbound assertion accuracy contrast >= .15 and margin contrast >= .5

causal_discovery.pairs: one target (family index modulo 2), permutation zero, per family; no error-conditioned selection
causal_discovery.goal_position: strictly after every causal anchor; no readout/answer-token patching
causal_discovery.state_alignment: equal full prompt token length and anchor positions required
causal_discovery.selection: directional mean margin >= .25, >=20% strict repairs, then maximum directional mean margin

locked_endpoint.numerical_controls: capture replay and exact BF16 identity; singleton execution
locked_endpoint.claim: causal contribution under this frozen contrast/site, not a complete algorithm

statistics.unit: lexical family; targets/labels/frames are repeated measures
statistics.behavior: descriptive contrasts and 4000 family-bootstrap draws; no confirmatory behavioral p claims
statistics.locked: 10000 seeded family-level sign flips, plus-one correction; one frozen site

instrument.batch_failure: predeclared singleton fallback within same invocation

accounting: one persisted coordinator ledger; reserve full timeout plus buffer before each dispatch; unknown/failed charges retain reservation; no automatic retries
